summary: Expose a separate native database-archive capacity/growth gauge from hourly filesystem accounting, without changing the hot database objective or activating archival

replay.detail: No graph replay. The new local sample history is derived filesystem measurement state.

schema.detail: No database schema, claim kind or storage-version change. Bounded derived samples use the new wire_archive_size_samples/v1 meta namespace.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule change.

compatibility.detail: Adds an informational database-archive row to the native store report. The existing database target and budget remain unchanged. Missing/stale/unavailable measurements never become zero-byte successes; integrity and catalogue coverage are explicitly not proved by capacity scans.

manual.detail: No archive directory is created and no writer or hot-row removal is activated. A never-measured missing root reports not-activated.

recovery.detail: Reverting stops the additional sampler/row. Existing binaries ignore the derived sample namespace; original wire evidence and hot persistence are unchanged.
